title: Anthony and the fish
hook: a legend: when no one listens, Anthony preaches to the fish

segments.voice: Yesterday, the Third Order: following Francis without leaving home. Your line was francis at home. Where did your one habit turn up in an ordinary place? Day one thousand two hundred seventeen.

A friar has walked into Rimini, a city on the sea, to preach. Here, nobody will listen. The Little Flowers says people in the city had turned against the Church's teaching, and they won't come to hear him. The friar is Anthony, later known as Anthony of Padua, one of Francis's brothers. The obvious next move: leave. Shake the dust off. Complain about Rimini for a week. Anthony walks down to where the river meets the sea, stands on the bank, and starts preaching to the water.
screen: `A CITY THAT WON'T LISTEN.` → `ANTHONY OF PADUA.` → `HE PREACHES TO THE WATER.`

segments.voice: He calls out: hear the word of God, you fishes of the sea and of the river, since the people won't. And in the legend they come. So many fish gather that the water fills with them, all with their heads above the surface, all facing him, and in order: the little ones close to the shore, the middle-sized behind them, the big ones out in the deep. Then Anthony preaches, and like Francis with the birds, he counts out what God has given them. God gave you water, fresh and salt, he says. He gave you places to shelter from storms, and food. When the flood came and the animals outside the ark perished, you were kept alive. God chose a fish to carry the prophet Jonah and set him safe on land. A fish brought up the coin that Peter paid as tax. And after he rose, Christ himself ate fish. At this, the story says, the fish open their mouths and bow their heads, as if to praise. Word gets around. People come running down to the river to see, and the ones who had refused to listen come too. They're moved, and they fall at Anthony's feet, and now he preaches to them. That's the happy ending, but notice the order. Anthony doesn't preach to the fish as a trick to win the crowd back. Nothing in the story says he expected anyone to come. He preached because preaching was his work, and the fish were who was there. Saint Paul tells Timothy, in the Douay-Rheims: "Preach the word: be instant in season, out of season." In season is when they're listening. Out of season is the riverbank.
screen: `HEAR THE WORD OF GOD, YOU FISHES.` · `HEADS ABOVE THE WATER, IN ORDER.` · `WATER, SHELTER, JONAH, A COIN.` · `HE PREACHED BEFORE ANYONE CAME.` · then, large: `IN SEASON, OUT OF SEASON.`

segments.voice: Here's the practice: speak kindly, even unheard. Settle, and breathe. Think of someone who doesn't really listen to you right now. A teenager behind a closed door. A coworker who talks past you. A parent who hears what they expect. Instead of rehearsing the argument, find one true, kind sentence you could say to them, whether or not it lands. Say it silently, slowly, as if to the water. Then let go of whether it's heard. If you pray, you can give that sentence, and that person, to God. If you don't, simply breathe and let the words rest. The bell holds the time.
Anthony and the fish. A legend of a preacher refused by a city, who preached to the fish, and was heard. Today's word.
Your line: preach anyway. Today, say your kind sentence out loud to the one who doesn't listen, once, and leave the result alone. Day one thousand two hundred seventeen.

howItsDone: Catholics honor Saint Anthony of Padua as a Franciscan preacher, and his sermon to the fish is a favorite subject in Franciscan art and storytelling.

fork.setup: you're Anthony. you came to Rimini to preach, and nobody will listen. what do you do?
options: leave for a city that wants you.
go to the riverbank and preach to the fish.
stand in the square and scold them.
fork.reveal: in the legend he preaches to the fish, and only afterward do the people come running to listen.

trapdoor: what you thought: a cute miracle about talking to fish.
what it means: a preacher who keeps doing his work when no one listens, and is heard in the end.
what a scholar hears: the Little Flowers sets the story at Rimini, and Anthony's sermon lists the fish of Jonah and of Peter's coin from scripture.

Check: Rimini; heretics refusing to hear (rendered neutrally as people who 'had turned against the Church's teaching'); the shore where river meets sea; the fish in order by size; the sermon's gifts (fresh and salt water, refuges from storms, food, preserved in the flood, Jonah, the tribute coin, Christ eating fish); the fish bowing; the townspeople and heretics coming and being converted.
Matthew 17:26 is Douay numbering for the coin in the fish's mouth (17:27 in KJV); confirm reference.
